text: Abraham had pleaded for Sodom. In Genesis 22 the three days of travel have the force of a suspended sentence; outwardly nothing happens, though in significance everything happens. The servants, the wood, the knife, and the fire are carefully named; the instruments of the act are present before the act itself has taken place. Faith in this story has the form of a structured relation or arrangement. Obedience stands beside horror, and neither prevails.
